source_statement: Rectangle R0 has sides of lengths 3 and 4. Rectangles R1 , R2 , and R3 are formed such that: • all four rectangles share a common vertex P , • for each n = 1, 2, 3, one side of Rn is a diagonal of Rn−1 , • for each n = 1, 2, 3, the opposite side of Rn passes through a vertex of Rn−1 such that the center of Rn is located counterclockwise of the center of Rn−1 with respect to P . R3 R2 R1 R0 Compute the total area covered by the union of the four rectangles.
